title: AR-Edit: Training-Free Autoregressive Video Editing without Inversion
title_zh: AR-Edit：无需反演的免训练自回归视频编辑

paragraphs.en: AR-Edit通过缓存并注入源值特征，实现免训练无需反演的实时自回归流式视频编辑。 Editing a video stream in real time, without access to future frames, is essential for interactive applications. Existing training-free video editing methods, however, assume full offline access to the entire sequence, while streaming approaches either rely on additional training or are limited to specific editing techniques. We show that this limitation can be removed by analyzing the self-attention dynamics of DMD-distilled autoregressive (AR) video diffusion models. We uncover a key asymmetry: queries and keys remain stable and aligned with their source counterparts across denoising timesteps, while values diverge and encode the evolving content. Inherited from the non-distilled bidirectional teacher, this asymmetry is strongest at high noise, where few-step streaming models operate. The resulting mechanism is simple: a single forward pass suffices to capture source identity in the value features, which can be reused throughout generation. Starting from pure Gaussian noise and injecting only these source values reconstructs the input with fidelity matching or surpassing inversion-based methods, effectively eliminating inversion. Based on this insight, we introduce AR-Edit, a training-free, inversion-free method that caches source values once and selectively injects them during denoising. Across multiple AR backbones, AR-Edit enables real-time streaming editing with superior source preservation and tonal fidelity at minimal overhead.
paragraphs.zh: AR-Edit通过缓存并注入源值特征，实现免训练、无需反演的实时自回归流式视频编辑。在无法访问未来帧的情况下实时编辑视频流，对于交互式应用至关重要。 然而，现有的免训练视频编辑方法都假设可以完整离线访问整个序列，而流式方法要么依赖额外的训练，要么仅限于特定的编辑技术。 我们证明，通过分析经DMD蒸馏的自回归（AR）视频扩散模型的自注意力动力学，可以消除这一限制。 我们揭示了一个关键的不对称性：查询和键在各去噪时间步上保持稳定并与源视频对应部分对齐，而值则发生偏离并编码不断演变的内容。 这一不对称性继承自未经蒸馏的双向教师模型，在高噪声水平下最强，而少步流式模型正是在高噪声下运行的。 由此得到的机制十分简单：仅需一次前向传播即可在值特征中捕获源视频的身份信息，并可在整个生成过程中复用。 从纯高斯噪声出发，仅注入这些源值就能以媲美甚至超越基于反演方法的保真度重建输入视频，从而有效消除反演步骤。 基于这一洞察，我们提出AR-Edit，这是一种免训练、无需反演的方法，它只需缓存一次源值，并在去噪过程中选择性地注入。 在多个AR骨干网络上，AR-Edit能以极小的开销实现实时流式编辑，并具备更优的源视频保持能力和色调保真度。
